title: Bergstrom Base Future, Waste Services
summary:
*   City officials held a worksession to discuss plans for transforming **Bergstrom Air Force Base into city property**, including a comprehensive transition strategy.
*   Discussions included a detailed "Airport Issue Paper" and future development plans for the Bergstrom site, highlighting a significant municipal infrastructure project.
*   An update was also provided on the city's ongoing **Solid Waste Services Plan**, reviewing current operations and future considerations.

1. Aviation Issue Paper
Assistant City Manager Joe Lessard introduced the 1992 Airport Issue Paper Volume II to
Council. He stated there are a number of items to work on before the transition occurs,
changing Bergstrom from an
Air Force Base to City property.
Charles Gates, Director of the Airport, illustrated and discussed the development of the
transition plan by means of slides and charts. Copies are on file in the City Clerk's
office.
(Councilmember Epstein left the Council Chamber at 2:30 P.M.)
2. Solid Waste Business Plan Update
Joe Lessard introduced Joe Word, who went over the Solid Waste Services Plan Update. A
copy is on file in the City Clerk's office.
Mayor Todd left the meeting at 3:15 p.m., Councilmembers Larson and Reynolds left the
meeting at 2:28 and 3:31 P.M. respectively.
